remote-workspace.title: View execution workspace
remote-workspace.intro: View files in the current attempt. With write permission, edit complete text and save against its original digest.
remote-workspace.target_hint: Lists currently authorized native attempts. Eligibility does not verify connection health.
remote-workspace.truncated: Showing up to {{limit}} items. Narrow the scope on the Runs page.
remote-workspace.no_targets_help: Start an approved native workspace task, then refresh. Live files are unavailable after that attempt ends.
remote-workspace.empty_directory: No visible files in this directory.
remote-workspace.basis_help: The digest identifies the complete file read. This live snapshot is not test or acceptance evidence.
remote-workspace.editor_help: Preview is read only. With write permission, edit complete text. Built-in editor menus remain in English; platform actions support Chinese and English.
remote-workspace.invalid_response: The response does not match the current project or attempt. Refresh to continue.
remote-workspace.expired: This read has expired. Refresh the files to read again.
remote-workspace.error.workspace_closed: The execution attempt ended. File content has been hidden.
remote-workspace.error.workspace_unavail: The execution workspace is unavailable. Check the run state.
remote-workspace.error.path_not_allowed: This path is outside the allowed read scope.
remote-workspace.error.file_missing: The file no longer exists. Refresh the directory.
remote-workspace.error.text_required: Only text files can be read.
remote-workspace.error.output_limit: The file or result exceeds the read limit. Choose a smaller text file.
remote-workspace.error.cursor_stale: The directory changed. Read again from the first page.
remote-workspace.error.file_changed: The file changed. Read it again from the first section.
remote-workspace.error.sensitive_content: Sensitive-content protection blocked the file body.
remote-workspace.error.request_invalid: The read request is invalid. Refresh and choose again.
